realm_description: A dense, patient forest that rewards those willing to grow at nature's pace. Trust, healing, and quiet resilience all take shape here, far from the noise of the capitals.

primary.label: Historian
primary.description: Gathers what happened — triumphs and shameful parts alike — so no one can pretend it didn't.
primary.guiding_promise: I will remember honestly, even when forgetting would be easier.
primary.shadow_description: Cannot let the past go, and lets old grievance calcify into bitterness dressed as memory.

secondary.label: Messenger
secondary.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
secondary.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
secondary.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

wheel.central_question: Should we preserve what happened, or keep alive the story of who we are?

growth.label: Messenger
growth.description: Bridges people and truths that wouldn't otherwise connect.
growth.guiding_promise: I carry only what is real, to those who need it most.
growth.shadow_description: Carries everyone else's message so faithfully that their own voice goes quiet.

other_ally.label: Philosopher
other_ally.description: Chases understanding for its own sake, deeper than any single answer.
other_ally.guiding_promise: I will not stop asking until the world reveals what it truly is.
other_ally.shadow_description: Keeps asking the next question until the moment for an answer has already passed.

quarter.label: Builder
quarter.description: Driven to make things real with their own hands.
quarter.guiding_promise: I will make something real that endures long after I am gone.
quarter.shadow_description: Cannot put the work down long enough to notice what it has quietly cost them.

opposite.label: Storyteller
opposite.description: Keeps identity, memory, and meaning alive across generations; around their fire, people remember who they are.
opposite.guiding_promise: I will keep telling the story, so no one forgets who we are.
trait_descriptions: Keep the soul alive in words.
opposite.shadow_description: Polishes the story so bright that the truth underneath quietly disappears.

realmmate.label: Sage
realmmate.description: Lets truth settle slowly; offers wisdom gently to those still searching.
realmmate.guiding_promise: I will wait for the truth to settle, and share it without needing credit.
realmmate.shadow_description: Waits so long for the truth to settle that it's no longer useful by the time they speak it.

wheel.compatible_text: Sage · Custodian — fellow travelers of The Living Forest.
